photo-for-print.title: How to pick a photo that prints beautifully
photo-for-print.excerpt: Resolution, light and composition: what makes a photo look sharp on a phone case.
photo-for-print.p1: A phone case is small, but print is unforgiving. A photo that looks fine on your screen can turn soft once it is stretched over the whole back of a case. The good news: a few simple checks make the difference.
photo-for-print.p2: Start with resolution. Use the original file from your camera or phone, not a screenshot or an image saved from a messaging app, which are often heavily compressed. The designer warns you when an image is too small for the size you've chosen.
photo-for-print.p3: Light matters just as much. Photos taken in daylight, with clear contrast between the subject and the background, print far better than dark indoor shots. If a photo is very dark, brighten it a little before uploading.
photo-for-print.p4: Finally, mind the camera cutout. Keep faces and important details away from the top corner where the camera sits; the 3D preview shows you exactly what will be covered.

persian-typography.title: Persian typography on a phone case
persian-typography.excerpt: Choosing between Vazir, Naskh and Lalezar, and how to make a name stand out.
persian-typography.p1: A name or a short line of poetry is one of the most personal things you can print. Persian letters are beautiful, but each font gives them a very different voice.
persian-typography.p2: Vazir is clean and modern and stays readable at small sizes. Naskh has the calm rhythm of classic books, perfect for a line of verse. Lalezar is bold and playful and works best for a single short word.
persian-typography.p3: Contrast is key: light text on a dark design, dark text on a light one. If the background is busy, place the text over a calmer part of the image or add a soft band behind it.
persian-typography.p4: Mixing Persian and English? The designer sets the text direction from the first letter, so both read naturally. Try it in the hero above: type a name and watch it on the case.

clear-or-color.title: Clear, black or white: which case is right for you?
clear-or-color.excerpt: How the case colour changes the look of your design.
clear-or-color.p1: The case colour is the canvas under your design. With a full-bleed design it barely shows, but with a small logo or a name it becomes part of the look.
clear-or-color.p2: A clear case lets the colour of your phone shine through, which is great for minimal designs. Black makes bright colours glow, while white keeps pastel and light designs fresh and crisp.
clear-or-color.p3: Not sure? Switch the colour in the designer and turn the case around in 3D. What you see is what we print.

info.title: Info & help
info.lead: Everything about polySaz, ordering, shipping and the most common questions.

about.title: About us
about.p1: polySaz is a small team of designers and makers who believe everyday objects should feel personal. We built a designer that shows your case in 3D, exactly as it will be printed.
about.p2: Every case is printed to order with your design, checked by hand and carefully packed.

shipping.title: Shipping & payment
shipping.p1: Orders are printed and shipped within three working days. Delivery usually takes one to three days more depending on your city.
shipping.p2: You can pay online with any bank card. You'll receive an order confirmation and a tracking code by text message.

material.q: What are the cases made of?
material.a: Flexible, shock-absorbing TPU with a hard printed back, so the case protects your phone and the print stays sharp.

quality.a: No. We use UV-cured inks that resist scratches, sunlight and daily wear.

time.a: Up to three working days for printing and shipping, plus one to three days for delivery.

photo.q: My photo is low resolution. What can I do?
photo.a: The designer warns you when an image is too small. Use the original file, or make the image smaller on the case.

return.q: What if something is wrong with my case?
return.a: If the print or the fit isn't right, contact us within seven days and we'll reprint it for free.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: Questions about an order or a custom project? Message our support team, we usually reply within a few hours on working days.
